title: refactor(ci): modernize workflows, improve cache parallelism and release hygiene
author: Asha Patel
ci_checks: lint: pass (python flake8, ts/eslint) after auto-fix commit
integration-tests: pass (retries x2 for flaky network tests)
e2e: flaky on first run (timing), rerun passed
cache-cleanup: run and cleaned stale keys (reduced CI time by ~18%)
description:
Motivation: our CI workflows have accumulated multiple one-off jobs and outdated action usages which increases maintenance burden and CI time. This PR modernizes the lint/test/release pipelines, consolidates job matrices, improves cache parallelism and cleaning, and applies a set of dependency hygiene updates.

Summary of changes: consolidated multiple GitHub Actions workflows into a smaller set (ci.yml, lint.yml, release.yml), standardized Node/Go/Python versions across jobs, introduced a cache key sharding strategy to reduce cache contention (cache key = runner + job + hash(workspace deps)), added a periodic cache-cleanup job to remove stale artifacts, and simplified release automation to use the upstream release-action with deterministic changelog generation. Also applied a small set of dependency bumps for actions and devtooling (actions/checkout v4 -> v4.1.0, actions/cache v4 -> v4.0.2, node-version bump matrix -> 20.x).

Files affected (high level): workflows and helper scripts, CI tooling under tools/ci/, a handful of package/devtool lockfiles updated. No production code changes.

Performance/regression notes: after these changes CI median runtime for lint+tests dropped ~20% on average in the sample runs (reduced duplicated setup and cache misses). A known flaky e2e was retried and marked for follow-up (ENG-4250).

Migration notes for maintainers: the legacy workflow files under .github/workflows/legacy-* are safe to delete after two weeks of no regressions; a migration checklist is included below. Release automation now requires a repo tag secret (GITHUB_TOKEN still works for most orgs; see release.yml notes).

Checklist: [x] consolidate workflows, [x] standardize runtimes, [x] implement cache sharding strategy, [x] add cache-cleanup scheduled job, [x] bump action versions, [x] run full CI and iterate on flaky tests, [x] update contributor docs (CONTRIBUTING.md change included).

Related: ENG-4123 for infra perf targets, ENG-4250 tracking e2e flakiness follow-up.

release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows for lint/test/release, improved cache parallelism and added scheduled cache cleanup; bumped CI action versions and standardized runtimes. Expected CI runtime reduced ~20% in sample runs. No runtime-impacting production changes. See ENG-4123 and ENG-4250.
